s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly growing vascular tumor on the scalp
salient_findings: 8-mm red, firm, mobile nodule on the left temporal scalp
Irregular red lacunae with irregular vessels and absence of septa on dermoscopic evaluation
Well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels and intravascular branching papillary structures on histopathology
key_facts: The patient is a man in his 40s
The patient has no significant medical history
The tumor is located on the left temporal scalp
The tumor is 8-mm in size
The tumor is red, firm, and mobile
Dermoscopic evaluation shows irregular red lacunae and irregular vessels
Histopathology shows a well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor
The tumor extends to the superficial subcutaneous tissue
The tumor is composed of ectatic thin-walled vessels with intravascular branching papillary structures
The endothelial cells have numerous intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules
PAS staining is positive for hyaline globules in the cytoplasm of endothelial cells
Tumor vessels are positive for CD-31 and negative for D2-40 and HHV-8

shortlist.label: Glomeruloid hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathology shows a well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels and intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules, consistent with Glomeruloid hemangioma

shortlist.label: Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Dermoscopic evaluation shows irregular red lacunae and irregular vessels, and histopathology shows papillary structures, consistent with Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma

shortlist.label: Hobnail hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathology shows a well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels and papillary structures, consistent with Hobnail hemangioma

shortlist.label: Epithelioid hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathology shows a well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels and endothelial cells with intracytoplasmic hyaline globules, consistent with Epithelioid hemangioma

shortlist.label: Dabska tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathology shows a well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels and papillary structures, consistent with Dabska tumor

raw.rationale: The presence of intravascular branching papillary structures, ectatic thin-walled vessels, and endothelial cells with numerous intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules, along with positive PAS staining and specific immunohistochemical markers (CD-31 positive, D2-40 and HHV-8 negative), are characteristic features of Dabska tumor.

rejected.label: Glomeruloid hemangioma
rejected.why: Lack of glomeruloid structures in the histopathology description

rejected.label: Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma
rejected.why: Negative D2-40 staining does not support this diagnosis, as D2-40 is typically positive in lymphatic vessels

rejected.label: Hobnail hemangioma
rejected.why: The described features do not include the typical hobnail appearance of endothelial cells

rejected.label: Epithelioid hemangioma
rejected.why: The histopathological features do not match those of epithelioid hemangioma, which typically shows epithelioid endothelial cells
